channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: ICICI Life Insurance Defends Credit Cover Amidst Commission Cut Proposal
item.description: ICICI Life Insurance reported a 25% year-on-year increase in net profit for the second quarter, reaching Rs 374 crore, with premium income rising 16%. The company's management defended its credit-linked protection plans, emphasizing their… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Bond Yields Decline Amid Inflation Data Anticipation
item.description: Global bond yields, including those for U.S. Treasuries and in the Eurozone, have decreased as markets await the release of U.S. inflation data. The decline in yields is partly attributed to a pullback in energy prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: India's September retail inflation at 5.54%, food inflation at 7.74%
item.description: India's retail inflation rate was 5.54% in September, according to data released. Food inflation specifically rose to 7.74% during the same month. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Adjust Investment Strategies
item.description: BlackRock has shifted its investment strategy, becoming bullish on short-term bonds and downgrading its outlook on stocks. In contrast, Goldman Sachs has adopted a long position on both stocks and bonds. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.description: Investors are reassessing the artificial intelligence memory chip trade, with "easy money" no longer guaranteed, as evidenced by a "brutal session" for chip stocks. This indicates a turning point in the AI-driven market. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Google has launched the Fitbit Edge, a new fitness tracker featuring a color display and a replaceable battery. The device is priced at $180 and includes features such as ECG capability and a battery life of up to seven days. Forbes noted… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: The Social Security Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) for 2027 is set to be announced on Wednesday. Projections suggest this COLA could deviate from historical norms, although challenges remain. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Kroger plans to eliminate 3,000 corporate roles over the next three years, according to a memo, as the company increases its use of artificial intelligence. The layoffs will affect corporate employees. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Japan-controlled tankers return to Middle East after conflict
item.description: Japan-controlled oil tankers have resumed voyages to the Middle East after a seven-month absence due to conflict in the Persian Gulf. Refiners and shipowners had previously avoided the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
